messages:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT P1 - Billing metering anomaly detected for multiple customers. Metric: display_count != ingested_count. Trigger: threshold breach on metering-agg job. Paging oncall.

mike_oncall: Got the page, looking. Any customer-facing impact known?

rachel_prodops: We're seeing UI counts underreporting for some accounts since ~02:10 UTC. Ingestion and storage look fine — raw events present, but the aggregation pipeline output is lower.

ryan_billing: Confirmed gaps on dashboard and invoices preview. We haven't emitted final invoices yet but deferred charging risk if counts are wrong. Prioritizing.

samir_sre: I see errors from the metering-agg service: intermittent timeouts to the redis cache followed by partial aggregation windows. Logs:
```
2026-06-18T02:12:40Z metering-agg WARN shard-3: reduce_window timeout after 3s; partial emit
2026-06-18T02:12:40Z metering-agg ERROR write_aggregate failed: ErrWriteConflict
```

mike_oncall: Reproduced locally with a canary run. Root cause likely a recent config change to `agg_window_ms` rolled out ~02:05. Rolling that back to previous value now.

rachel_prodops: Heads-up for status page: customers may see underreported usage in the dashboard and invoice previews. No confirmed overcharging reported. Draft status update below — feedback?

rachel_prodops: "We are investigating an issue affecting usage metrics displayed in the Redwood Console. Some customers may see lower-than-expected usage totals and invoice previews. Our engineers are working to restore accurate aggregation. We will provide updates within 30 minutes."

elaine_custsu: Suggest adding "no charges have been applied yet for impacted invoices" to reduce anxiety.

ryan_billing: Agree. Also add a note that we'll run a reconciliation job and reach out if adjustments needed.

mike_oncall: Rollback started. Monitoring redis connections and agg output. Patch command I ran:
```
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/metering-agg AGG_WINDOW_MS=15000 --record
```

ops-bot: deploy/metering-agg rollback triggered by mike_oncall at 1769054500. CI job passed.

samir_sre: After rollback, agg output for canary window looks stable. Reprocessing queue still has partial windows; will kick a backfill for the last 2 hours.

mike_oncall: Running backfill for impacted windows. Command:
```
./scripts/metering_backfill --from 2026-06-18T00:00:00Z --to 2026-06-18T02:30:00Z --service metering-agg
```

rachel_prodops: Draft status update v2:
"We are investigating an issue affecting usage metrics displayed in the Redwood Console. Some customers may see lower-than-expected usage totals and invoice previews. No charges have been applied for affected invoices yet. Engineers have identified a recent configuration change as the likely cause and initiated a rollback. We are running a backfill to restore accurate metrics. We will post another update within 60 minutes or when we have further details."

elaine_custsu: Good. Can we also prepare a short email template for customers on paid plans? I'll personalize if we triage a follow-up.

rachel_prodops: Email draft:
"Hi <CustomerName>,

We identified an issue where usage displayed in the Redwood Console and invoice previews may be lower than actual usage between <start> and <end>. We have rolled back the configuration that caused this and are running a reconciliation process. No charges have been finalized; if any adjustments are required after reconciliation, we'll notify you with a clear explanation and correction. Estimated completion: within 4 hours. Sorry for the inconvenience.

Best,
Redwood Inference Support"

ryan_billing: We'll also run a billing reconciliation script and produce an audit CSV for customers who request it. Command to hydrate audit export:
```
python tools/generate_billing_audit.py --jobs 8 --since 2026-06-18T00:00:00Z --until 2026-06-18T02:30:00Z --output /tmp/billing_audit.csv
```

samir_sre: Backfill progress: 0/18 windows processed. I'll stream progress here. If backlog grows > 2x normal, we'll scale workers.

ops-bot: autoscaler notice: metering-backfill job scaled from 2 -> 8 workers at 1769055100.

mike_oncall: First backfill windows finished — re-aggregated counts increased for canary accounts. Looks good.

rachel_prodops: Posting status page update now. Content posted to status.redwood.com/incidents/12345

elaine_custsu: Notifying top 10 enterprise customers via email thread + account reps. Using the draft above with ETA = 4 hours.

rachel_prodops: Internal comms template for CS/Sales:
"We detected a metering aggregation issue causing underreported usage in the Console and invoice previews between <start> and <end>. A rollback has been applied; backfill and reconciliation are in progress. No charges have been finalized. Expected completion within 4 hours. If you have high-priority customers, escalate to billing@redwood.com."

samir_sre: Backfill progress update: 8/18 windows processed, avg time/window 22s, no errors. Reconciliation run queued.

ryan_billing: Kicking reconciliation now. It will compare raw event counts -> aggregated totals -> invoice drafts and produce deltas. Running in dry-run first.

mike_oncall: Dry-run reconciliation shows deltas for ~2.4% of accounts (mostly large ingest clients). No overcharges expected; deltas correct towards higher counts.

rachel_prodops: Update to status page: added note "We expect usage counts to be fully reconciled within 4 hours. If you are impacted, you will receive an email and a CSV audit on request." (timestamped)

elaine_custsu: Customers reached out with concerns. Triage: prioritize customers with enterprise contracts and any accounts with >1% delta.

ryan_billing: Reconciliation finished (dry-run). Creating customer-facing adjustment plan. Will run live reconcile and update invoices only after approvals from finance. Estimated additional time: 1-2 hours.

samir_sre: Final check on metering-agg stability: 30m without redis timeouts. Reprocessing completed 18/18 windows. All canaries green.

mike_oncall: Escalation handoff: I'm handing to rachel_prodops for ongoing communication and to ryan_billing for reconciliation ops. Oncall covered until 1800 UTC. @rachel_prodops @ryan_billing please ack.

rachel_prodops: Ack. I'll continue status updates and customer comms.

ryan_billing: Ack. I'll coordinate with finance and CS for adjustments.

elaine_custsu: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the enterprise list and share CS notes.

ops-bot: Incident resolved: metering aggregation restored and reconciliation completed. Final status: partial underreporting from 02:05-02:30 UTC due to config change. No customers charged incorrectly. Post-incident actions:
- run postmortem
- add guardrail to config rollout for agg_window_ms
- add alert when partial windows emitted

mike_oncall: Adding postmortem checklist to /docs/incidents/1769054321-postmortem-draft.md

rachel_prodops: Closing thread once postmortem and customer emails done. :white_check_mark:
